title: Idempotent retry
contract: A request ID credits one unit at most once despite duplicate delivery or lost acknowledgement; distinct delivered IDs each credit once.
scope: All delivery sequences length 0..4 over IDs 0,1; lost acknowledgements modeled only by repeated delivery; single durable atomic receiver.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Final credit equals cardinality of distinct delivered IDs.

variants.description: Use a set of IDs and compute credit from set size.
